_note: Moonshift's own fleet (FLEET_SOURCE=own, what npm run demo runs): tasks execute only on GPU-A and GPU-B, the GPUs whose shareholders the task pays. External offers in the catalog are the market benchmark only: benchmark names the GPU model and the provider to price against (AWS): the cheapest AWS on-demand offer for that GPU sets the Guaranteed and Priority rates, the cheapest AWS spot offer sets the Pausable rate (optimizer.service_levels). pricePerHourUsdc is the price when the catalog has no such offer. endpoint ${COMPUTE_URL} = served through services/compute (GPU-A: the real Akash T4, with resume); empty = the in-process worker (GPU-B, the mock).
